function.name: create_order
function.description: Submits a new order to the system for a specified customer, including a list of products and their quantities. This is the primary function for initiating a purchase and will trigger downstream inventory and fulfillment processes.

customer_id.description: The unique identifier for the customer placing the order.

order_id.description: The unique identifier for the newly created order, which can be used for tracking.

estimated_delivery.description: The estimated delivery date for the order, provided in ISO 8601 format.

status.description: The initial status of the order upon creation, typically 'pending' or 'processing'.

function.name: track_shipment
function.description: Get tracking details for a shipment.

function.name: calculate_reorder_level
function.description: Calculates the ideal stock level at which to reorder a product based on its sales velocity and supplier lead time.

product_id.description: The unique identifier of the product being analyzed.

avg_daily_demand.description: The average number of units of the product sold per day, calculated over the last 90 days.

lead_time_days.description: The typical number of days between placing an order with a supplier and receiving the inventory.

reorder_level.description: The calculated stock quantity threshold. A new order should be placed when inventory drops to this level.

calculation_timestamp.description: The UTC timestamp indicating when this reorder level was calculated.
